{{Quote|He wants me to flee? No, attack. Set fire to Ord Mantell. Wait, that's wrong. Freeze the oceans of Manaan. Changing commands. Which are lies? What is truth? Can't live like this. Help me. Kill me.|Suri, to the [[Hero of Tython]] and [[Kira Carsen]]|<ref name="The Emperor's Orphans" />}}
'''Suri''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
===Child of the Emperor===
Early in her life, the Empire learned that Suri had a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|strong connection to the]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] and she was sent to the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the ancient Sith world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. During her training, she became friends with [[Kira Carsen]], and like her, she would become a [[Children of the Emperor|child]] to the Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], the ruling founder of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|True Sith Empire]].

===Reunion with Kira===
After the [[Dromund Kaas operation|Emperor's defeat]], Suri summoned her friend on [[Voss]], asking Kira to free her from the voice of the Emperor that she continued to hear in her head. Kira and [[Hero of Tython|her Master]] spoke with her and tried to convince her to follow them on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], but in that moment, a couple of Children of the Emperor appeared. One of them, [[Tannac]], explained that only he and his brethren were able to help Suri. After some thinking Kira and the Hero let her go with Tannac. Later, Kira and the Hero wondered how was it possible that Suri heard the Voice of the Emperor, if they already killed him.

===Confrontation with the Sith Emperor===
At some point, Suri had somehow perished. During the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|final confrontation]] with [[Tenebrae]], Suri was among the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] that were summoned to help the [[Outlander]] to defeat the former Sith Emperor, thus witnessing his final [[Death/Legends|defeat]]. With Tenebrae gone, Suri found peace and became one with the Force.<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=General|Echoes of Oblivion|Kira Carsen's ship}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Hero has the option to fight with Tannac. Suri joins the fight and the Hero is forced to defeat her.
